$description: The words Wingtip Maps says the same on the web, the iPhone and Android: the names of the controls, the figures and the sections a pilot meets on all three, and the messages they share (progress, errors, empty states). scripts/build/wording.sh generates apps/web/src/lib/wording/generated/wording.ts (WORDING), apps/ios/Wingtip/Design/Generated/Wording.swift (Wording, each a String(localized:) so the string catalog keeps it) and apps/android/app/src/main/res/values/wording_strings.xml (R.string.wording_<key>), and the table in docs/design/rules.md, section 18; CI generates them again and fails on a difference. Change a word here, never in a generated file or a copy in an app. Each word's kind is checked as it is generated (docs/design/rules.md, section 18, decision 0021): a label (a title, a heading, a button, a menu item, a tab, a row's or a figure's name) is in Title Case, the FAA's codes kept; a sentence (a message, an error, an empty state's line) begins with a capital and ends with a full stop or a question mark; progress is a sentence that ends with one ellipsis character; a value (what a figure reads) is in sentence case with no full stop. Screen titles are design/screens.json's, not here.

planning_aid_title.about: About's heading over the planning aid's words.

planning_aid_notice_title.text: A Planning Aid, Not for Navigation
planning_aid_notice_title.about: The planning aid's notice, where an app shows it on its own.

planning_aid.text: Wingtip Maps is a planning aid for VFR and IFR flight. It does not replace an official weather briefing (1800wxbrief.com or 1‑800‑WX‑BRIEF), current FAA charts and publications, or the pilot in command’s judgement and final authority (14 CFR 91.3, 91.103). Its checkpoints are a model’s suggestions: check them against the chart. Before flight, verify current weather, NOTAMs, TFRs, airport status, aircraft performance, and applicable regulations (14 CFR 91.103).
planning_aid.faa: "aircraft performance" is 14 CFR 91.103's own subject, kept as the rule says it.
planning_aid.about: What the app is and is not, in About and at the briefing's foot (14 CFR 91.3, 91.103; docs/legal/credits.md, "A planning aid").

planning_aid_kneeboard.text: Wingtip Maps · a planning aid: check the charts, NOTAMs and an official briefing before flight.
